name: Parenthese
description: A family tree you host yourself. Each person gets photos, videos, voice recordings and stories. Relatives open the tree from a link without an account, and can suggest additions that the owner approves. This container runs everything (PostgreSQL, API, web app) and needs no setup. It creates its database and keys in the appdata folder on first start.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Database, photos, videos and generated keys. Back up this folder.

ports.name: Web port
ports.description: Port where Parenthese opens in the browser

variables.name: Allow registration
variables.description: false: nobody can create an account any more. Existing accounts keep signing in, relatives still open shared trees with the link and password. An instance with no account still accepts the first one, so create yours right after the first start.
